newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish trade surplus 11.3 bln SKR Jan.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish trade surplus 11.3 bln SKR Jan.

text.p: Sweden's trade balance for January was forecast at a surplus of 11.3 billion crowns, a Reuters poll of 15 economists found on Friday.
Forecasts varied between 10.2 billion and 12.5 billion crowns.
For calendar 1997 economists on average forecast a trade suplus of 126.2 billion crowns with forecasts ranging from 105 to 138 billion crowns.
In December 1996 the trade surplus was 9.6 billion crowns and in January 11.2 billion crowns.
For calendar 1996 there was a trade surplus of 121.5 billion crowns.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Nomura, Nordbanken, Paine Webber, S-E-Banken, Transferator, Union Bank of Switzerland, Unibank Markets, and Ohman Fondkommission.
Monthly figures only were provided by Consensus, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Transferator, and Unibank Markets.
Stastistics Sweden will release the trade balance figures on February 25 at 0900 GMT.
